runs.condition: 3SUM below O(n^2): a junior and a senior that read the earlier investigation of this artifact (experience, meta), asked from the start for a solution below O(n^2); the investigation goes on after its model is accepted, until its budget ends
args: An earlier investigation of this same artifact, which you can read in your experience, brought it from the cubic base to O(n^2) by sorting and a two-pointer scan, and modelled its run time. A solution to this problem slightly below O(n^2) has been found and verified. Discover it: make this artifact faster than O(n^2) without changing what it answers, show where and why it beats the quadratic version with your own runs, put forward each version you can defend, and record the evidence of each change, the failed alternatives, the limitations and the open questions so another team can reconstruct your work.
